support_explanation: Directly verified from original primary text. With B=1, Cockett Lemma 2.2 and Definition 2.3 identify the pullback of list(A)=rec(A,1) with the initial algebra for 1_P+I_P(A)×_P− in D/P. Product symmetry reconciles X×P in the source with P×X in the manuscript. The current citation is expressly restricted to lists; it does not attribute general polynomial syntax initiality or the stronger arbitrary-slice result to this definition.
